WaterAid dashboard assets — research release 0.2.0

16 transparent PNGs rasterised from four original SVGs on WaterAid's official website.
Logo widths: 320, 640, 1280, 2560 pixels.
Water, sanitation and hygiene icon widths: 64, 128, 256, 512 pixels.
Heights follow the original aspect ratios. Do not force assets into square boxes.
White logo: blue or dark backgrounds. Blue icons: white or cream backgrounds.
No artwork has been redrawn or recoloured. These are conversions, not new logo designs.
Source URLs and SHA-256 values are recorded in assets.json. Conversion date: 17 October 2026.
WaterAid retains its artwork rights; this pack does not grant a new licence or imply endorsement.
